definitions.full: H141. Adoniram אֲדֹנִירָם proper name, masculine ( my Lord is exalted ) official of Solomon 1Kin 4:6 ; 1 Kings 5:28; so also 2Sam 20:24 ; 1Kin 12:18 ᵐ5 We Dr Sm .
